title: Motion (Lee - Rodriguez) relative to: 1) preparing an ordinance to amend the Los Angeles Municipal Code regarding the floor area of Accessory Dwelling Units…
text:
[Council File 16-1468-S5]
Motion (Lee - Rodriguez) relative to: 1) preparing an ordinance to amend the Los Angeles Municipal Code regarding the floor area of Accessory Dwelling Units (ADU); 2) Department of City Planning (DCP) to report on the impacts of Senate Bill (SB) 9 and SB 1211 on attached ADU development within the City of Los Angeles; and, 3) DCP report on any additional local regulatory options available under State law to preserve neighborhood compatibility while maintaining compliance with State ADU mandates.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Prepare ordinance amending Accessory Dwelling Unit floor area regulations and report on impacts of State Senate Bills on ADU development.

details.action: Prepare ordinance and report on ADU regulations

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee approved as amended (Sep 22, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 6, 2026)
